replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body:
[Denied] - I apologize, but your map has been denied for use on the Avicus Network and will not appear in either repository or rotations. Your map has been denied for the following reasons --
→ Too plain. How could you make it look more appealing?
→ Poor palette. How could you make the blocks have less "noise"?
→ Poor mashing. How could you make the blocks be consistent?
→ Too rough. Could you make it less rough and more smooth?
